mapper.sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.term, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_enrollments e WHERE e.class_id = c.id AND e.role_in_class = 'STUDENT') AS students FROM classes c
mapper.select: JOIN class_enrollments t ON t.class_id = c.id AND t.user_id = #{callerId} AND t.role_in_class = 'TEACHER' ORDER BY c.created_at DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT u.id, u.username, u.email, u.status, (SELECT MAX(s.updated_at) FROM classroom_sessions s WHERE s.user_id = u.id) AS lastActivity, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM classroom_events e JOIN classroom_sessions s ON s.id = e.session_id WHERE s.user_id = u.id) AS steps FROM class_enrollments e JOIN users u ON u.id = e.user_id WHERE e.class_id = #{classId} AND e.role_in_class = 'STUDENT' ) t ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.lastActivity IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, t.lastActivity DESC, t.id
SELECT username, email FROM users WHERE id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM classroom_bookmarks WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM classroom_sessions WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT MAX(updated_at) FROM classroom_sessions WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_enrollments WHERE class_id = #{classId} AND user_id = #{callerId} AND role_in_class = 'TEACHER'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_enrollments t JOIN class_enrollments s ON s.class_id = t.class_id WHERE t.user_id = #{callerId} AND t.role_in_class = 'TEACHER' AND s.user_id = #{studentId} AND s.role_in_class = 'STUDENT'
